simpleweather.title: Simple Weather
text.autoconfig.simpleweather.option.dis:
Stops rain and thunder from occurring and
clears active weather. Server-side. Default:
false.
text.autoconfig.simpleweather.option.cli:
Reduces rain particles and sounds. 100 = All
particles/sounds 0 = No particles/sounds
(Silent). Default: 20. Allowed range: 0–100.
text.autoconfig.simpleweather.option.rai:
How often rain starts: the dry spell between two
rains is divided by this factor. 1 = Vanilla,
2 = twice as often, 0.25 = four times as rare.
Rain length stays Vanilla. Default: 1. Range:
0.25–4.
text.autoconfig.simpleweather.option.thu:
How often thunderstorms start, same scale as the
rain factor (own countdown). Default: 1. Range:
0.25–4.
simpleweather.guide.page.1.title: Simple Weather
simpleweather.guide.page.1: Weather switch on the server and rain density on the client. A sub-mod of Simple Quality of Life, also playable alone.
simpleweather.guide.page.2.title: Disable weather
simpleweather.guide.page.2: disableWeather (default false, server) clears rain and thunder and skips weather progression.
simpleweather.guide.page.3.title: Rain and thunder frequency
simpleweather.guide.page.3: rainFrequencyFactor and thunderFrequencyFactor (default 1 = Vanilla, bounded 0.25–4, server) speed up or slow down the countdown between two rains or storms:
simpleweather.guide.page.4.title: Rain and thunder frequency
simpleweather.guide.page.4: 2 = the dry spell is half as long, 0.25 = four times as long. Rain and storm length stay Vanilla; /weather clear <time> stays exact. Change with /simpleweather config set rainFrequencyFactor 2.
simpleweather.guide.page.5.title: Rain density
simpleweather.guide.page.5: clientRainParticleDensity is a local visual preference, default 20, bounded 0–100: thins rain in the air, ground particles and rain sounds; it never changes server weather.
simpleweather.guide.page.6.title: Sub-mod of Simple QoL
simpleweather.guide.page.6: Playable alone (config/simpleweather.json). Bundled in Simple QoL, which can switch it off with "Enable Simple Weather".
simpleweather.guide.page.7.title: Sub-mod of Simple QoL
simpleweather.guide.page.7: On the first start the old Simple QoL weather settings are taken over once.
simpleweather.guide.page.8.title: Commands
simpleweather.guide.page.8: /simpleweather config shows and changes every option of config/simpleweather.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values). Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once.
